moduleTitle: Creating custom action steps with Copilot in Tricentis Testim
learningObjectives: Use Testim Copilot to generate a custom action step's JavaScript from a plain-text description.
Use the Coding Assistant's Explain and Fix commands to understand and repair existing custom-step code.

studyGuide.sectionTitle: Generating custom steps with generative AI

elements.description: Uses generative AI to automatically create JavaScript code for custom code steps from a text description — letting less-technical testers produce working custom action steps without hand-writing the JavaScript themselves.

Create a custom step, then click 'Write code with AI'. Inside the assistant's chat, typing '/' surfaces special commands. For Generate specifically, you type a prompt describing the desired code, press Enter (or click Send), and the generated JavaScript appears directly in the chat pane.

elements.title: The Coding Assistant's three core commands
items: Generate — produce new custom-step JavaScript from a plain-text description.
Explain — select existing JavaScript and get a readable description of what it does.
Fix — analyze code that's producing an error and get a suggested fix.

bulletPoints: Testim Copilot generates custom-step JavaScript from a plain-text description.
'Write code with AI' → chat with '/' commands → Generate / Explain / Fix.
This lowers the JavaScript bar for testers who aren't primarily developers, without removing the option to hand-edit the result.

examPitfalls.title: Assuming Copilot-generated code needs no review
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Accepting AI-generated custom-step code without reading or testing it, on the assumption that generative AI output is automatically correct.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Treat Generate as a fast first draft. Use Explain to confirm the generated code actually does what was intended, and review/test it like any other custom step before relying on it.

practiceQuiz.scenario: What does the 'Generate' command in Testim Copilot's Coding Assistant do?

options.text: Deletes unused custom steps from the project.
Creates new custom-step JavaScript automatically from a plain-text description.
Converts a custom step into a built-in predefined step.
Runs the test suite and generates a report.

practiceQuiz.hint: It's about writing new code from a description, not managing existing steps.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Generate produces new custom-step JavaScript from a text description using generative AI, letting less-technical testers create custom-coded steps without hand-writing JavaScript from scratch.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A tester inherits a custom action step with confusing JavaScript and no comments. Which Coding Assistant command helps them understand what it does?
practiceQuiz.hint: They need a description of existing code, not new code or a bug fix.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Explain takes selected JavaScript and produces a readable description of what it does — exactly suited to understanding inherited or confusing custom-step code. Generate creates new code, and Fix targets code producing errors.

practiceQuiz.scenario: How is the Coding Assistant opened for a custom step?

options.text: By clicking 'Write code with AI' after creating the custom step.
It opens automatically for every step in the test.
By right-clicking the test name in the Test Library.
Through the project's Settings > API page.

practiceQuiz.hint: It's a button specific to custom code steps.
practiceQuiz.rationale: To use Testim Copilot Coding Assistant, you create a custom step and click the 'Write code with AI' button, which opens the chat interface supporting the Generate/Explain/Fix commands.
